provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Marks the person or group something comes from, with verbs of receiving, borrowing, learning and hearing (兄貴に助けてもらう, あいつに金を借りる, 親方に教わる). Sibling lanes point the other way or elsewhere: the person told or given something (親に言う), a destination (東京に戻る), an attitude aimed at someone (子供に優しい), and the one who can or knows (俺には無理だ). から replaces に once the source is an organization (会社から連絡をもらう).

examples.ruby: その技[わざ]はうちの親方[おやかた]にゃ教[おそ]わらなかった。
examples.english: That trick isn't one I picked up from our boss.

examples.ruby: あいつにゃ何度[なんど]も金[かね]を借[か]りてるんだよ。
examples.english: I've borrowed money off that guy more times than I can count.

examples.ruby: 困[こま]った時[とき]はいつも兄貴[あにき]にゃ助[たす]けてもらった。
examples.english: Whenever I was in a jam, my big brother was the one I got help from.
